method: Source-familiar AI proxy over fixed authored dice and keyboard UI runs. No blind players, physical devices, screen-reader listening, perceptual audio scores or automatic craft grade.

browserCampaigns.limitations: Internal authored campaign, not blind or fresh-player observation. Synthetic viewport and pagehide, not physical hardware or app switch. Voice completion and cleanup do not establish listening quality. Transition times include UI review/reloads; they are not INP or field percentiles.
